resources.string: A layered paper-cutout landscape that scrolls across your screen, with the sun and moon following the time of day.
The sun and moon move based on your device\'s clock (or your location, if enabled)
Calculate precise sunrise and sunset times based on your area
Tap dogs, penguins, gifts, cars, or the background to make a paper bird fly
PaperScrape is an open-source live wallpaper inspired by classic "paper cutout" animated backgrounds. Source code available on GitHub.
